group: Factory instance uniqueness - repeated calls with same flag

cases.expected: two distinct JsonSchemaFactory instances (different object references) returned on successive calls
cases.description: Calling getInstance with the same supported flag multiple times should produce separate factory objects (no caching of a singleton).

group: Custom builder interaction via overload - null customizer should behave like simple call

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchemaFactory instance identical in configuration to the one returned by getInstance(versionFlag) without customizer
cases.description: When the overload getInstance(versionFlag, null) is used internally, it must produce the same result as the single‑argument version; this case verifies that the factory’s meta‑schema id matches the expected Draft‑06 identifier.
When a non‑null customizer throws an IllegalArgumentException, getInstance(versionFlag, customizer) must propagate that exception unchanged.
If the customizer lambda throws a generic RuntimeException, the method must not catch it and should let it bubble up to the caller.

group: Customiser sets null version flag - should raise IllegalArgumentException

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "versionFlag must not be null"
cases.description: A customizer that attempts to set a null version flag on the builder must cause an IllegalArgumentException, mirroring the validation performed in the factory method.
